meta.description: Ticks the Tier-1 RSS collector (app/news/collector.py) so the news_headlines tool has something to read. Pure Python on the backend — no model, no tokens — fetch/dedup/store across every enabled feed, plus watchlist matching. A keyword hit escalates itself to a NightCrawler push turn from inside the collector; this workflow does not do that part. Safe to activate as-is.

nodes.name: Every 10 minutes
nodes.notes: News is cheap to over-poll — it's a handful of RSS fetches, not a per-item LLM turn — so every 10 minutes keeps the store fresh without meaningfully touching the host. Dedup in the collector means a quiet cycle inserts ~0 rows.

nodes.name: Igor: poll news
nodes.notes:
Returns {enabled, feeds, fetched, new, flagged}. `enabled:false` means NEWS_POLL_ENABLED is off in the backend's own settings — this workflow ticking is not what controls that.

neverError: one bad cycle (a slow feed, a transient 5xx) must not turn into a failed n8n execution logged every 10 minutes forever. There is nothing here to react to per-run; if the store stays empty for a long stretch that's a backend log to check (news_feed_failed), not something this workflow should retry hard for.
